name: What is the average cost of a roof replacement in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a roof replacement in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a roof replacement in Orange County can vary significantly based on several factors, including the size and pitch of your roof, the type of materials you choose (e.g., asphalt shingles, tile, metal), and the complexity of the installation. For a standard asphalt shingle roof on an average-sized home, prices typically range from $10,000 to $25,000. Premium materials or more complex designs can increase costs. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after a thorough inspection of your specific property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs in Orange County vary, typically $10,000-$25,000 for asphalt shingles, depending on roof size, material, and complexity.
